The Boeing Company is hiring an Associate or Experienced Software Engineer for its Space Intelligence & Weapons Systems Daybreak team. The role develops, integrates, maintains, and modernizes software for mission-critical processing workflows, including cloud deployment, specialized data processing, and software lifecycle support.

Responsibilities
Designs, develops, tests, and maintains software components and applications using Python, C, and C++ to support mission-critical processing workflows
Analyzes, debugs, and integrates existing algorithms and legacy applications; develop interfaces and wrappers to make software capabilities available to higher-level applications and services
Evaluates legacy implementations and dependencies to determine appropriate approaches for integration, modification, refactoring, or selective rewriting
Develops and maintains software for ingesting, parsing, validating and processing specialized data formats and associated metadata
Packages, containerizes, and rehosts software applications in AWS cloud environments, supporting reliable execution and integration with existing cloud services
Use cloud tools and infrastructure-as-code technologies, such as Pulumi, to configure application resources, manage deployment dependencies, and support repeatable software deployments
Develops, tests, and delivers software using GitLab and CI/CD pipelines, supporting automated builds, testing, integration, and deployment
Troubleshoots software issues across application code, data formats, native libraries, interfaces, dependencies, and deployment environments
Develops automated tests, validation procedures, and error handling to ensure software reliability, data integrity, and maintainability
Integrates software components into existing architectures and processing pipelines; support deployment, verification, and ongoing operational maintenance
Participates in Agile software development activities, including iteration planning, backlog refinement, and team collaboration within a SAFe framework
Collaborates with software engineers, system engineers, and stakeholders to translate technical requirements into effective software solutions
Documents software designs, interfaces, dependencies, and integration procedures to support long-term sustainment and reuse

Required
This position requires an active U.S. Top Secret Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship Required) with eligibility for SCI access pre-start (A U.S. Security Clearance that has been active in the past 24 months is considered active)
A final U.S. Top Secret/SCI Security Clearance pre-start is required
Bachelor's Degree or higher
1+ years software development experience
This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee
Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status
Preferred
5 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), chemistry, physics, mathematics, data science, or computer science and 5+ years of related work experience OR Bachelor's Degree and 9+ years of directly related work experience OR 13+ years of related, relevant experience
Experience developing software in Python and C/C++
Experience integrating existing algorithms, libraries, or legacy applications
Familiarity with Python interfaces to native code and software interoperability
Experience with AWS cloud services and deploying applications in cloud environments
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Pulumi, Terraform, or AWS CloudFormation
Familiarity with GitLab, Git-based version control, and CI/CD pipeline configuration and troubleshooting
Experience parsing structured or binary file formats and working with associated metadata
Familiarity with radar or signal processing algorithms, or other specialized data-processing applications
Experience with automated testing and continuous integration
Experience working in Agile software development environments, preferably using the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)
Benefits
Variable compensation opportunities
Eligible employees generally may enroll in health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and programs providing paid and unpaid time away from work; availability may vary based on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and applicable collective bargaining agreements.
401(k) plan matching contributions dollar for dollar, up to 10% of eligible pay, with immediate 100% vesting.
Eligible enrolled U.S. employees can have qualified student loan debt payments counted, along with any match-eligible contributions, for determining the Company Match to their Boeing 401(k) accounts.
